title: About VPN Access Policy Data Diagnostics

blocks.text: The Access Policy Data Diagnostics page provides logs and diagnostics data for traffic that matches an access policy rule. Traffic that does not match any access policy rules is blocked by default, and you can also view that data on this page. The logs displayed on this page can help you troubleshoot issues.
The Access Policy Data Diagnostics page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View, monitor, and analyze access policy action data for your organization.
Take appropriate actions based on the policy action data displayed.

blocks.heading: About the Access Policy Data Diagnostics Page

blocks.text: On the Access Policy Data Diagnostics page (Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > Diagnostics > VPN Diagnostics > Access Policy Data), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the data displayed by a time range, or use a custom time range.
Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
Select the VPN Service Edge you want to view the data for.
View the number of total bytes allowed and blocked for users' VPN connections. Click the chart icon () to view byte history in charts.
See image.
View the number of total packets allowed and blocked for users' VPN connections. Click the chart icon () to view packet history in charts.
See image.
Show or hide the filter options.
Apply filters to the data displayed. To learn more, see Using Tables.
View a list of all access policies for your organization. For each policy, you can see:
Rule Order: The rule order in which the access policy rules are applied to the traffic.
Name: The name of the access policy rule.
Source Networks: The source networks configured in the access policy rule.
Destination Networks: The destination networks configured in the access policy rule.
Protocols: The protocol for the traffic (TCP or UDP).
Source Ports: The port number for the source traffic.
Destination Ports: The port number for the destination traffic.
Rule Action: The action triggered by the traffic for the configured rule (Allow or Block).
Bytes: The bytes of the data handled during the session.
Packets: The number of packets exchanged during the session.
History: Click the chart icon () to view the access policy rule history in charts.
Access Policy Rule History

The policy rule history drawer contains two charts, Bytes and Packets, showing the bytes of data and the number of packets transferred by all the traffic that triggered the access policy rule, respectively. You can filter the data displayed by a time range, or use a custom time range.
You can hover over the chart to view the values at different points in time. Use the slider under each chart to zoom in or out of time.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Select another diagnostics page to view:
User Logs: View user logs for your VPN connections.
Traffic Flow Logs: View traffic flow logs for your VPN connections.
